result:
Post revisions are working. `bun run typecheck` passes, lint is clean, and `bun test` passes 8 of 8, including 6 new feature tests. The new tests run the worked example (edit "First" to "Second" to "Third", then restore "First"). They also check: no revision on create or on a refused edit, 403 for other users, the `/login` redirect for guests, 404 for a revision from another post, and that deleting a post removes only its own revisions.

The previous version and the edit are saved in one transaction, so an edit can't go through without its revision being kept.

I added a `post_revisions` table to `db/schema.ts` with a cascading foreign key to `posts`, plus a generated migration in `db/migrations/20260929162600_add_post_revisions/`, and a `PostRevision` model in `app/Models/PostRevision.ts`. In `app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts`, `update` now keeps the current title, excerpt and body as a revision before saving. Two new actions are behind the `auth` middleware in `routes/web.ts`: `revisions` handles `GET /posts/:id/revisions` and passes `revisions: [{ id, title, createdAt }]`, newest first. `restoreRevision` handles `POST /posts/:id/revisions/:revisionId/restore`; it looks the revision up only within that post (so another post's revision gives a 404), keeps the current version as a new revision, restores the old one and redirects to `/posts/:id`. `destroy` deletes the post's revisions along with the post. Only the author can see or restore revisions, via a new `manageRevisions` rule in `app/Policies/PostPolicy.ts`. There's also a `PostRevisionParamSchema` in `app/Http/Validators/PostValidator.ts`, a new page at `resources/js/pages/posts/Revisions.tsx`, a "History" link for the author in `resources/js/pages/posts/Show.tsx`, regenerated `.guren/*.gen.ts` files, and the tests in `tests/PostRevisions.test.ts`.
